title: Bilingual Medical Virtual Assistant
description:
West Orange Nephrology is a kidney care clinic located in Winter Garden, Florida. Our team of experienced nephrologists provides personalized care across diagnostics, dialysis, laboratory services, and patient education. We are looking for a Virtual Medical Assistant to join our remote team. This position requires prior experience working in a US medical office or clinical setting.



About the role

You will support our providers and clinical staff by keeping the clinical day running smoothly and scribing for providers. Your responsibilities range from flagging urgent lab results to preparing charts before appointments and checking patients in and out for virtual visits. This role requires strong medical knowledge, sharp attention to detail, and the ability to communicate clearly with both patients and clinical staff. 



What you'll be doing

You will monitor and flag critical lab values to the appropriate provider in a timely manner, prepare and prep patient charts ahead of scheduled clinic visits, contact pharmacies to process and follow up on medication refill requests, and communicate with clinic staff to relay provider instructions and patient updates. You will also check patients in and out for telehealth visits, maintain accurate documentation in the EHR system, and ensure all tasks are completed in compliance with HIPAA regulations.



Who we're looking for

We need someone with experience as a medical assistant, clinical coordinator, or in a similar US healthcare role. Familiarity with nephrology, chronic disease management, or specialty clinic workflows is a strong plus. You should be comfortable reading and interpreting lab results, experienced with EHR or EMR systems such as eClinicalWorks, Athena, or Epic, and able to manage multiple tasks during a busy clinic day. Strong communication skills, attention to detail, and HIPAA training are all required.



Important

This position supports a US-based medical practice. US medical office or clinical experience is required. Candidates without US healthcare experience will not be considered.



How to apply

Send a short introduction about yourself and your clinical background. Please answer this question: "What EHR systems have you worked with, and what does your experience with chart prep or lab monitoring look like?" Applications that skip this question will not be reviewed.

This is not a role for someone who just wants to follow a storyboard and clock out. We need a creative who looks at a hook and immediately thinks of three ways to make it more engaging, faster, and higher-converting.



Our philosophy: we prioritize 10 ads at 80% quality over 2 ads at 100%. Speed and volume win in performance marketing. If you're someone who obsesses over pixel-perfect polish at the expense of output, this isn't the right fit.



The Role

You will own the creation of high-volume, high-performance video ads, targeting 10–20 videos per week depending on length. This includes short-form for Meta/TikTok, long-form VSLs, AI avatars, B-roll edits, and voiceover-driven content.



You'll work from creative briefs and scripts provided by our creative strategists and copywriters, turning direction into polished, high-converting assets at speed. You take deep pride in ownership, turn raw footage and AI outputs into systematic creative machines, and ensure our creative output is a competitive advantage.



If you are a builder who thrives on iterating based on data rather than just "vibes," we want to talk to you.



What You Will Do

* Full-Spectrum Production: Create high-converting short-form ads (15–60s), UGC-style content, and long-form VSLs for Meta, TikTok, and YouTube.

* AI Mastery: Take full ownership of our AI tech stack, including Veo 3, HeyGen, Runway, and ElevenLabs for video, and Nano-Banana for statics, to produce high-quality AI video, avatar, and voiceover outputs at scale.

* Source Fresh Creatives: Proactively find and source fresh B-roll and visual assets from across the internet. You never run dry, and you never recycle.



What We're Looking For

Experience & Skills

* 2+ years of video editing experience, with specific experience editing for DTC brands or performance marketing.

* Technical mastery: Fluency in Premiere, Final Cut, or CapCut, plus advanced proficiency in AI video tools (Veo 3, HeyGen, Runway, ElevenLabs, Nano-Banana).

* Strategic thinking: Strong instincts for hooks, pacing, and storytelling in a Direct Response (DR) context.

* Resourcefulness: Proven ability to source fresh creatives, B-roll, and visual assets independently. You always have new material to work with.



Work Style

* Speed over perfection. You can move fast and deliver high volume without sacrificing the quality that matters.

* Implement feedback quickly, often same-day turnaround.

* Improvement-driven: You can demonstrate how you've personally improved a creative's performance through iteration or better editing workflows.

* Excellent English, clear written and verbal communication for seamless collaboration.

* Self-learner. You figure things out on your own. Whether it's a new tool, a new technique, or a new platform, you don't wait to be taught.

* Organized file structures and version control for rapid iteration.



Commitment

Full-time and exclusive. This role requires your full professional focus. We invest heavily in our people, training, tools, growth, and we're looking for someone who's equally invested in building something long-term with us.

title: CAD Drafter/CAD Manager
description:
The CAD Manager’s primary responsibility is to build a repeatable, easy-to-follow system and standard that makes this possible — consistently, at scale. This is a cornerstone position in our surveying operation. You won't just draft — you'll own the standard. From the Civil 3D template to the final plat, you set the bar, build the systems, and hold the line on quality. The goal is simple: one survey out the door per day, done right. Candidates must have hands-on experience producing plats in the United States; experience in Georgia is a plus. If selected, our hiring process includes 3 short, paid test assignments. These are designed to see how you actually work — not trick questions, just real tasks similar to what you'd do in the role.



What you'll own:

Civil 3D Template

Maintain the master template. Keep it error-free, up to date with state and county requirements, and optimized for throughput.



CAD Playbook & SOPs

Author and maintain written standards that a new drafter can follow without hand-holding. Keep it current in Confluence.



Contract Drafter Coordination

Identify capacity gaps, delegate work clearly with defined scope and deadlines, and QC all output before it moves forward.



County & Municipality Communication

Own all submittal communication, manage redlines from receipt to resolution, and build real working relationships with reviewers.



What we're looking for:

Technical skills

Deep Civil 3D expertise — not just drafting, but building and maintaining the template itself: styles, label sets, description keys, and object layers

Experience with the Civil 3D API and using it as a foundation for automations and AI-assisted workflows

Proven production of Land Surveys, ALTAs, Topographic Surveys, and Boundary Surveys in Georgia

Familiarity with CALC files and what a field crew actually needs to do their job

Experience working with aerial and terrestrial LiDAR and photogrammetry integrated into Civil 3D deliverables



Communication

Writes clearly — SOPs, redline responses, county
s, and Confluence docs all need to be easy to follow

Comfortable on the phone or in writing when a submittal gets complicated

Communicates status and issues proactively, without being asked



Ownership & leadership

Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks — if a deliverable has a problem, you own getting it fixed

Can give direct, clear feedback without being harsh or vague

Teaches what they've built — automations and workflows are documented so others can use and build on them

Has the trajectory to lead a full CAD department — this role is the foundation for that growth



Deal breakers:

Blaming others when something goes wrong — ownership comes first, questions come second.

Strong CAD with weak communication — technical skill without communication is a liability in this role; we need both.

Waiting to be told what needs fixing — problems get identified and solved proactively.

Setting a standard you don't personally follow — the standard applies to you first.

Giving vague direction and calling it delegation — work gets handed off clearly, with scope, deadlines, and a QC step.

title: Senior Assistant Property Manager
description:
Senior Assistant Property Manager

Aoede LLC | 100% Remote | Full-Time



About the Role



The Senior Assistant Property Manager is a leadership role responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations of a growing, diversified real estate portfolio across Texas and California. This includes a 70-unit commercial building in Houston, TX, single-family rental properties in California, and short-term rental (Airbnb) properties in Austin, TX.



You will lead and supervise a team of Assistant Property Managers while personally handling complex operational, financial, and tenant matters. This is not an entry-level position — we need someone who has managed US properties, can make decisions independently, and is ready to own outcomes.



This is also not a role where you simply delegate and disappear. You need to be hands-on, involved in ongoing tasks, and ready to step in with guidance when a tea
mber needs it — or take over a task entirely when the situation calls for it. Our leadership philosophy is trust but verify: you empower your team to execute, then you follow up and confirm the work was done correctly.



This is a 100% remote, full-time, long-term position.



We do annual team bonding trips in the Philippines — if you're talented, hardworking, and ambitious, we'd love to meet you in person and talk about where your career is headed.



What You'll Do



Team Leadership

- Supervise and mentor Assistant Property Managers using a trust-but-verify approach — delegate clearly, follow up consistently, and confirm quality

- Stay hands-on with ongoing tasks — review work in progress, not just final outputs

- Step in to provide guidance, coaching, or direct support when tea
mbers are stuck or struggling

- Take over tasks when the situation requires it — no task is beneath you

- Apply project management principles to plan, track, and deliver property operations initiatives on time and within scope

- Schedule tea
etings, delegate tasks, and hold tea
mbers accountable for deadlines and quality

- Conduct training sessions using company runbooks and tutorials

- Serve as the first point of escalation for the team before matters reach ownership



Property Operations

- Oversee daily operations across a mixed portfolio of commercial, single-family, and short-term rental properties

- Ensure excellent customer service to all tenants, guests, and prospects

- Manage Airbnb listings, guest communications, and short-term rental operations

- Coordinate maintenance requests and vendor communication across multiple property types

- Ensure accuracy and timely preparation of all required reports



Tenant Relations & Legal

- Handle escalated tenant situations — complaints, disputes, and difficult conversations

- Prepare and serve legal notices (pay or quit, lease violations, cure or quit)

- Coordinate eviction processes with legal counsel and local authorities

- Ensure compliance with US property management regulations including Section 8, rent control, and tenant/landlord laws in California and Texas



Financial Management

- Participate in budget planning for properties across the portfolio

- Negotiate vendor contracts and pricing to optimize operational costs

- Set and review lease pricing based on market conditions

- Enter accounts receivable and accounts payable into QuickBooks

- Perform monthly bank reconciliations

- Monitor rent collections, track arrears, and escalate delinquencies



Documentation & Communication

- Draft lease agreements and manage property documentation

- Prepare and send communication notices to tenants

- Coordinate via Zoom, Slack, and Asana daily



What We're Looking For



- 2+ years of US property management experience (required — non-negotiable)

- Proven experience managing commercial, residential, or short-term rental properties in the US

- Understanding of Project Management (PMP) principles — you should be comfortable with scope management, task prioritization, risk identification, stakeholder communication, and delivering results on schedule. PMP certification is a plus but not required — what matters is that you think and operate like a project manager

- Experience leading and managing tea
mbers — you must have real examples of how you've delegated work, verified completion, coached tea
mbers through challenges, and stepped in to take over when needed

- A hands-on leadership style — you don't just assign tasks and walk away, you stay involved and ensure quality at every step

- Experience handling tenant escalations, legal notices, and eviction coordination

- Understanding of US property management regulations — Section 8, rent control, fair housing, and state-level tenant/landlord laws in California and Texas

- Proficiency in QuickBooks

- Expert-level use of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)

- Familiarity with property management software (AppFolio strongly preferred)

- Comfortable using Asana, Slack, and Zoom for daily communication

- Strong written and spoken English — you will be communicating directly with US tenants, vendors, and legal contacts

- Financially literate — comfortable with budgets, vendor negotiations, and lease pricing decisions

- Bachelor's degree preferred

- Dependable, proactive, and able to make sound decisions without constant oversight

- Must provide 3 work references from US-based individuals who can verify your US property management experience (this is required and will be checked before any offer is made)



What We Offer



- 100% remote position — work from home

- Long-term role with real growth potential into senior management

- On-the-spot bonuses for high performers

- Raises considered at performance evaluations for those who master the training material and execute at a high level

- Extensive runbooks and tutorials to support your development

- Annual team bonding trips in the Philippines

- A team culture that values hard work, initiative, and continuous learning



---



Our Hiring Process



1. Apply — Submit your application with the details listed below

2. Initial Review — We review your experience and qualifications

3. Assessment — Qualified candidates receive a TestGorilla skills assessment (~1 hour, webcam required)

4. Interview — Candidates who score at or above the 50th percentile are invited to a Zoom interview

5. Reference Check — We contact your 3 US-based references to verify your property management experience

6. Offer & Onboarding — Successful candidates begin with a 3-month probation period with full training and support



---



Frequently Asked Questions



What types of properties will I manage?

You'll oversee a diversified portfolio that includes a 70-unit commercial building in Houston, single-family rental homes in California, and short-term rental (Airbnb) properties in Austin. You'll also lead the team responsible for day-to-day management of these properties.



How is this different from the Assistant Property Manager role?

The Senior APM leads and supervises the APM team, handles escalated tenant situations and legal processes, and is involved in financial decisions including budgeting, vendor negotiations, and lease pricing. You are expected to operate independently and make sound decisions.



What leadership style are you looking for?

We believe in trust but verify. You delegate tasks to your team, trust them to execute, and then follow up to confirm the work was done correctly. But you're not just a manager — you're hands-on. You stay involved in ongoing tasks, provide guidance when tea
mbers need it, and take over tasks yourself when the situation requires it. If you're the type of leader who only gives orders from a distance, this role isn't for you.



Do I need a PMP certification?

PMP certification is a plus but not required. What we care about is that you understand and apply project management principles in your daily work — scoping tasks clearly, prioritizing effectively, identifying risks before they become problems, communicating proactively with stakeholders, and delivering results on time. If you naturally think this way, you'll thrive here.



What are the working hours?

You will be expected to work US Central Time business hours. This is a full-time position (40 hours/week).



How and when do I get paid?

Pay is on the 1st and 15th of each month via Wise (
).



Is this freelance or full-time?

This is a full-time, dedicated position. Freelancing or side work is not allowed. We need your full commitment.



Do you provide equipment?

You must have your own laptop, headset, and reliable high-speed internet connection.



Is there a probation period?

Yes, there is a 3-month probation period. After that, performance evaluations are conducted every 6 months.



How do raises and bonuses work?

We offer on-the-spot bonuses for exceptional work. Raises are considered at your 6-month performance evaluations based on how well you learn the training material, lead your team, and execute your responsibilities.



What training and support do you provide?

We have extensive runbooks, tutorials, and experienced tea
mbers to help you get up to speed on our specific processes. While we expect you to bring US property management knowledge, we'll train you on our systems and workflows.



What software will I need to know?

AppFolio (property management), QuickBooks (accounting), Asana (task management), Slack (communication), and Zoom (meetings). Proficiency in AppFolio and QuickBooks is strongly preferred for this role.



Why do you require US-based references?

We require 3 work references from US-based individuals to verify your US property management experience. This is non-negotiable. References should be former supervisors, clients, or colleagues who can speak to your property management work in the US. We will contact all references before extending an offer.



---



To Apply



Please include:

1. A summary of your US property management experience

2. What types of US properties you've managed (commercial, residential, short-term rental)

3. Your experience handling tenant escalations, legal notices, or evictions

4. Describe your leadership style — give a specific example of how you've delegated a task to a tea
mber, verified the work, and stepped in when guidance was needed

5. Any project management training, certifications, or experience (PMP, Agile, etc.)

6. What PM and accounting software you've used

7. 3 work references from US-based individuals (name, company, role, phone/email)

8. Your availability to start



About Aoede LLC



Aoede LLC is a Texas-based property management company overseeing a growing, diversified portfolio of commercial, single-family, and short-term rental properties across Texas and California. Founded with the mindset of a startup but built on enterprise-level professional experience, we move fast, build smart, and hold ourselves to a high standard.



Our team of 10+ professionals spans multiple countries and operates fully remote, managing everything from a 70-unit commercial building in Houston to Airbnb properties in Austin and single-family rentals in California. We hire talent from around the world — including the Philippines, Vietnam, India, Sri Lanka, Pakistan, Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, South Africa, Venezuela, and beyond. We don't care where you sit. We care how you perform.



What makes us different: we combine the speed and scrappiness of a startup with the processes, structure, and professionalism you'd expect from a much larger organization. We invest heavily in documentation — our runbooks and tutorials are built so that the right person can get up to speed quickly and operate independently. We reward performance, not tenure. If you learn the material, execute at a high level, and take ownership of your work, you'll grow here.



Our culture is built on communication, collaboration, and humility. We operate as a team — not in silos. Everyone, from leadership down, is open to feedback and willing to hear what they need to do to improve. We're not perfect and we don't pretend to be. What we do is strive for continuous improvement and learning every single day. Leadership is genuinely invested in finding better ways to do things, and we expect the same mindset from everyone on the team.



A Note on Honesty



We value honesty over impressive claims. Please don't tell us you're an expert in something you've only read about or briefly touched. It's okay to say "I've used AppFolio a few times but I'm not an expert" or "I haven't handled evictions before but I'm willing to learn." We will find out the truth — whether it's during the assessment, the interview, or the first week on the job. And when we do, it damages trust that's very hard to rebuild.



We would much rather hire someone who says "I don't know that yet, but I'll learn it" than someone who claims to know everything and can't deliver. Being humble, honest about where you are, and willing to put in the work to grow — that's what gets you far here. We have the training, the runbooks, and the team support to get the right person up to speed. What we can't teach is integrity.



We're actively expanding our portfolio and our team. We do annual team bonding trips because we believe the people behind the work matter just as much as the work itself.



This is a company where your work matters, your voice is heard, and your growth is directly tied to what you put in.

title: Creative Strategist & Meta Ads Specialist
description:
We're not looking for someone who just pushes buttons in Ads Manager.

PilatesGoods is a fast-growing B2B e-commerce brand selling premium pilates supplies to studio owners across Europe and USA (Netherlands, Germany, Belgium, Switzerland, UK). 



We need a Creative Strategist who can also run campaigns. Someone who understands why an ad works, not just that it works. The bridge between strategy and execution.



You'll work directly with our founder and our advisory team on weekly strategy calls. This isn't a "set it and forget it" media buying role. You'll drive creative direction, write hooks that convert, build static ads yourself, and use data to d
 what to test next.



If you've ever told a client their creative brief was wrong — and had the results to prove your version was better — keep reading.



What You'll Do:



Run Meta Ads across 5 European markets (€5,000+/month budget). Set up campaigns, manage budgets, test creatives, and optimize for cost per lead/conversion.



Drive creative strategy. Analyze what's working, identify winning hooks and angles, and tell our design team exactly what to produce next — not the other way around.



Write ad copy that converts. Short hooks, headlines, and body text for Meta ads. You know the difference between a cold audience hook and a warm retargeting message.



Build static ad creatives yourself. Canva, Adobe, or Figma — when our in-house designer is at capacity, you can produce feed-ready visuals on your own.



Read the data. Hook rate, CTR, CPL per creative. You don't just report numbers — you turn them into creative decisions. "This hook has a 2.3% CTR but a €18 CPL, so the landing page is the problem, not the ad."

Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to speed up copy, scripts, and concept development. We're an AI-forward team.



What a Typical Week Looks Like



Monday: Review weekend performance. Flag any creatives that need pausing or scaling. Prepare your update for the weekly call.

Tuesday–Thursday: Creative production. Write 3–5 new hooks. Brief the designer on 2 new static concepts. Make some concepts yourself. Launch 1–2 new ad variations. Analyze last week's test results and document winners/losers.

Friday: Weekly strategy call with our advisory team (1 hour). Present what you tested, what you learned, what you'll do next week. Send a written summary without being asked.



What We're Looking For

Must-haves (non-negotiable):



Proven experience running Meta Ads with €5,000+/month budgets

You can show us 3 ad creatives you personally made and explain why they worked

You write ad copy — hooks, headlines, body text — that actually converts

You can make static ad creatives yourself (Canva, Adobe, Figma, or similar)

You read data — hook rate, CTR, CPL per creative — and make decisions based on it

Working-level English. You write briefs, give feedback, and communicate clearly.

You're comfortable giving direct feedback. If something isn't working, you say so.



Strong pluses:



Experience with AI tools for content creation

Clear track record converting data into profitable ads

Experience in e-commerce or B2B lead generation

You've worked with European brands or markets before



What we DON'T want:



Someone who waits to be told what to do

Someone who only knows how to "boost posts"

Someone who avoids conflict and just says yes to everything

Someone who panics when CPL goes up for a week

Someone who isn't open to learning inside a growing e-commerce brand



Who You'll Work With



Jesse — our founder. Hands-on, fast-moving, built this from zero. He's been doing all marketing himself and needs someone to take ownership of the channel.

Quincy — our marketing advisor. Will coach you on creative briefs, copywriting frameworks, data optimization, and awareness-stage thinking. You'll learn a lot — you must be open to it.

Thomas — our strategic advisor. Direct communicator. Gives feedback without sugar-coating it. If you need your ego managed, this isn't the right fit. If you want to grow fast, it is.



How You Work Matters as Much as What You Know

We care about personality fit. Here's what thrives in our team:



You take ownership. You don't wait for instructions. You come with proposals. "I noticed our German CPL is 3x the Dutch one. I think it's the creative angle. Here's what I want to test."

You communicate proactively. You send updates before we ask. You flag problems early, not when it's too late.

You're direct. When a creative brief is weak, you say so. When an idea won't work, you explain why. No sugar-coating.

You stay calm under pressure. CPL will fluctuate. Campaigns will underperform sometimes. You treat bad data as a puzzle to solve, not a reason to panic.

You're structured. You track what's live, what's being tested, and what won. You have a system — we don't care which one, as long as it works.



We will ask you to complete a Big 5 personality test in the next round of hiring, so we can get to know you personally.



What You Get

Full-time remote position (20 hours/week)

Weekly 1-on-1 strategy sessions with our advisory team

Direct coaching on creative strategy, copywriting, and media buying

Real ownership of a growing brand's marketing — not just task execution

A team that values directness, speed, and results over politics

Growth path: as PilatesGoods scales, your role and compensation grow with it



How to Apply

Don't just send your resume. We want to see how you think.



Send us a Loom video (max 5 minutes) reviewing one of our current ads. Look us up in the
 Ad Library — search for "PilatesGoods" — and pick an ad. Tell us what's working, what's not, and what you'd change. Be specific and honest — we value directness over diplomacy.



Include 3 examples of ad creatives you personally made. For each one, tell us: what was the hook, who was the audience, and what result did it get?



Write 2 headlines for PilatesGoods that you think would work for Dutch pilates studio owners. Show us you can think about this audience.



We reply to every serious application within 48 hours. If you copy-paste a generic cover letter, we'll know — and we won't respond.



To apply, please start your application with the word "PILATES" so we know you read the full post.

PilatesGoods is based in the Netherlands and works with a remote team. This role requires overlap with European working hours — at least 4–5 hours overlap with CET (roughly 2:00 PM–7:00 PM Manila time).

title: SEO Specialist
description:
SEO Specialist — GWIN HVAC & MRCOOL DIRECT 



What This Role Requires & What’s Expected



The Strategy You’re Stepping Into:



We’re building a pillar page + topic cluster SEO structure around the keyword “DIY mini split” to rank #1 on Google and get cited by AI tools (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews). You need to understand and execute this architecture — not learn it from scratch.



What You Must Know How to Do



1. Pillar Page Management

 • Build and optimize a long-form authority page (2,000–10,000 words) targeting a broad head keyword

 • Structure it with proper H1/H2/H3 hierarchy, internal links to all cluster pages, E-E-A-T signals (author bios, credentials, reviews, trust badges)

 • Optimize title tags, meta descriptions, URL structure



2. Topic Cluster Execution

 • Write or manage 10–15 supporting cluster articles, each targeting a long-tail keyword

 • Every cluster article must bidirectionally link to the pillar — they need to understand why and enforce it

 • Know the difference between a pillar topic and a cluster topic



3. Schema Markup

 • FAQ schema, HowTo schema, Product schema

 • Know which schema types trigger Google features (People Also Ask, Featured Snippets, AI citations)

 • Work with a developer to implement correctly — not just generate JSON-LD and walk away



4. Keyword Research

 • Identify head keywords vs. long-tail keywords

 • Know search intent (informational, commercial, transactional)

 • Build a keyword map across the pillar and all cluster pages with no cannibalization

 • Know that we’re specifically targeting unbranded searches competitors aren’t owning



5. Backlink / Paid Article Campaign

 • Manage outreach to relevant websites for paid/editorial placements

 • Understand that these links must point primarily to the pillar page to pass authority

 • Vet domain quality (DA, relevance, real traffic — not link farms)

 • Track which links are live, where they point, and what anchor text is used



6. Technical SEO Basics

 • Page speed optimization (WebP images, lazy loading)

 • Mobile-first layout awareness

 • Canonical tags, redirect management (singular vs. plural URLs — we’ve dealt with this)

 • Google Search Console monitoring — impressions, clicks, ranking positions, crawl errors



7. On-Page Optimization

 • Know the right keyword density (not over-stuffing)

 • Bold strategic terms in content — but selectively (4–6 max per page)

 • Optimize image alt tags with 1–2 keywords per image

 • Write meta descriptions that convert clicks, not just include keywords



8. AI Search Visibility (Non-Negotiable in 2026)

 • Understand that Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity pull from well-structured, self-contained pages

 • Know how to write content that gets cited by AI engines (declarative sentences, FAQ structure, comprehensive single-page answers)

 • Schema markup is part of this — you need to connect these dots



9. Blog / Content Calendar Management

 • Plan and prioritize cluster articles based on keyword opportunity

 • Write directly

 • Know that every blog post needs a strategic internal linking plan before it’s published



10. Analytics & Reporting

 • Google Search Console — weekly check on rankings and impressions

 • Google Analytics — track organic traffic, time on page, bounce rate

 • Report on which cluster pages are ranking and which need work

 • Track backlink profile growth (Ahrefs or SEMrush)

What’s Already in Place (You’re Inheriting)

 • Pillar page at /diy-mini-splits — partially built, actively being expanded

 • Several cluster blog articles need to live on the site

 • Paid article / backlink campaign underway targeting the pillar

 • Schema partially implemented on product pages

 • YouTube channel with growing content

 • Keyword master reference list built out Green Flags to Look For in Candidates

 • Has managed a pillar + cluster structure before (show us an example)

 • Understands E-E-A-T and can explain it without prompting

 • Knows the difference between schema types and when to use each

 • Has run a backlink outreach or paid placement campaign and can show results

 • Follows Google’s guidelines — not black-hat tactics that will get the site penalized

title: Lead Editor
description:
Lead Video Editor — Full-Time, Salaried (Personal Brand / Creator Content)



 $640 USD/month



 40 hrs/week | Monday–Friday | 7am–3pm EST



Full-time, salaried, long-term



Remote (Philippines-based)



---



About the role



We're hiring a Lead Video Editor for a fast-growing personal brand in the lifestyle, travel, and finance space. The brand owner is relocating to West Africa, building a multi-continent operation, and the content reflects that — travel, food, deal-making, podcast conversations, and a quiet-luxury aesthetic that has nothing to do with the typical hype-driven finance creator look.



This is a leadership role first, an editing role second. Your primary responsibility is making sure the right content goes out at the right quality on the right schedule — by delegating to and managing one Assistant Editor, running the weekly cadence, quality-checking everything before it ships, and reporting on output. You'll edit priority pieces yourself when needed, but the role exists to **own outcomes**, not to be the highest-volume editor on the team.



If you've cut for personal brands, creators, or executive thought leaders before — and you're ready to step into a managing role with one editor under you — this is built for you.



---



What you'll do



Primary — leadership and oversight (the bulk of the role)



- Maintain brand standards across every piece — tone, pacing, color, captions, audio

- Delegate editing tasks to the Assistant Editor with clear briefs and deadlines

- Quality-check every piece from the Assistant Editor before it goes to brand-owner review

- Own the content pipeline from raw footage to ready-to-post (Google Drive workflow)

- Run weekly cadence: Monday kickoff, Wednesday midweek sync, Friday report

- Communicate daily via WhatsApp with the brand owner and operations lead

- Track output, KPIs, and pillar mix; flag blockers proactively

- Report on weekly output, performance, and pipeline health



Secondary — editing as needed:



- Edit priority short-form pieces (Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, podcast clips)

- Edit long-form content (full podcast episodes, YouTube videos, brand pieces)

- Step in on complex cuts & advanced edits the Assistant Editor isn't ready for



---



**What we're looking for**



This is a senior role.



- 3+ years of paid video editing experience for creators, personal brands, or content-driven businesses

- Proven experience editing both short-form and long-form content

- Portfolio that demonstrates quality & effectiveness

- Strong eye for color, audio, captions, and pacing

- Native-or-fluent English (you'll create captions, review the Assistant Editor's captions, and brief them)

- Comfortable leading and managing  — delegating tasks, giving feedback, holding standards

- Premiere Pro AND/OR DaVinci Resolve fluency (CapCut OK as secondary)

- Reliable internet, dedicated workspace, capable editing machine

- Available to work 7am–3pm EST consistently — non-negotiable for daily team sync



---



What we offer



- $640 USD/month, paid monthly

- Full-time stable salary

- Long-term role — we are building a brand we expect to be working on for years

- One brand, one client

- Clear systems, clear briefs, real direction (we have a full brand identity doc and content playbook — you won't be guessing what we want)

- Direct line to the brand owner and operations lead



---



How to apply



Send your application via (http://OnlineJobs.ph) internal messaging. Applications missing any of the items below will be auto-rejected.



**Your message must include:**



1. The first word of your message: **vantage**

2. Your resume or OnlineJobs profile link

3. Portfolio of **3–5 edits you personally cut** for personal brands or creators. Include both short-form AND long-form examples if you have them. Links only — no attachments.

4. A **60–90 second Loom video** answering this question: *"Walk me through one edit from your portfolio — why you cut it the way you did. Then tell me how you'd brief a junior editor to cut it the same way."*

5. Confirmation that you can work **7am–3pm EST, Monday–Friday**

6. Your current full-time commitments

7. A short answer (3–5 sentences): *"Why do you feel you'd be a good fit for this role?"*



We review every complete application. Thank you for not skipping steps.

title: Experienced Ecommerce Video Editor (UGC Ads)
description:
Sereni Parenting is looking for an experienced Ecommerce Video Editor with a proven track record editing high-converting ads for ecommerce brands.



This is not an entry-level role. We want someone who has edited real ads, for real brands, that had to perform. General content creation or personal projects only? This role isn't for you.



Who We Are



Sereni is a fast-growing parenting brand creating calming solutions for children. We're marketers obsessed with performance and emotionally driven storytelling. Our ads run on Meta and need to hook fast, hold attention, and convert.



What You'll Be Doing



Editing short-form UGC and AI-generated video ads (1–3 mins) for direct response. You'll work from detailed creative briefs, your job is to execute them accurately while creating ads that stop the scroll and drive action.



What We're Looking For



- 3+ years editing experience, with at least 2 years on paid social ads for ecommerce brands - name the brands, we'll ask.

- Strong grasp of direct response: hooks, pacing, retention, emotional pull

- Hands-on experience with AI tools such as ElevenLabs, Kling, or similar

- Proficient in CapCut and/or Adobe Premiere Pro

- Can source b-roll and stock footage independently

- Fast communicator who meets deadlines without being chased

- Able to follow creative briefs and revision notes precisely

- Learns quickly from feedback and applies revisions properly

- Strong attention to detail and consistency across edits



Communication and attention to detail are non-negotiable. If you ignore briefs, repeat the same mistakes after revisions, disappear during projects, or need constant follow-up, this role is not for you.



What We Offer



This is a full time, remote, per-project role with consistent daily work available. Editors who deliver 2 videos a day can expect to earn $1,000–$2,000+ per month. Editors who consistently deliver quality and volume move into a fixed full-time role within 2–3 weeks.



How to Apply



Your application must include all 3 or it will not be reviewed:



1. Resume: including specific ecommerce brands you've edited for

2. Portfolio : links to real ad creative you've edited (ads only, not general content)

3. Include the phrase "ECOMMERCE EDITOR" in your application title. Applications without both will be immediately rejected.

title: Hospice QA Coordinator (Home Health)
description:
DO NOT APPLY if you do not meet the qualifications listed below



Position Summary



We are seeking a detail-oriented and service-driven Virtual Hospice Quality Assurance (QA)  to provide after-hours, evening, and weekend support for hospice operations.



This role is primarily responsible for quality assurance, compliance monitoring, and documentation accuracy, while also supporting intake coordination, patient call management, scheduling follow-ups, and EMR documentation.



The ideal candidate has prior hospice or home health experience, strong knowledge of documentation compliance standards, excellent English communication skills, and the ability to remain calm and professional in time-sensitive or sensitive patient situations.



Key Responsibilities

Hospice Quality Assurance (Primary Focus)



• Review and audit patient charts to ensure compliance with hospice regulations and company standards

• Track and follow up on missing, incomplete, or non-compliant documentation

• Ensure timely upload of physician orders, certifications, and required hospice documentation

• Maintain organized QA logs, audit trackers, and electronic records

• Support compliance readiness for internal reviews and external audits

• Flag documentation discrepancies and escalate issues to appropriate leadership



Intake & Documentation Support



• Assist with hospice intake processing and referral coordination

• Upload and track physician orders, certifications, and care plans in EMR

• Monitor and manage endorsement and handoff reports

• Ensure all documentation is complete, accurate, and filed timely



Scheduling & Care Coordination



• Schedule and confirm follow-up visits for hospice patients

• Coordinate with field clinicians, intake teams, and office staff

• Assist in care coordination and communication workflows

• Escalate urgent clinical or operational concerns as needed



Patient & Call Support



• Answer and triage incoming patient, family, and caregiver calls

• Provide compassionate, professional customer service aligned with hospice care standards

• Accurately document all interactions in EMR

• Route concerns promptly and appropriately



Qualifications & Requirements

Required



• Prior healthcare experience (hospice or home health strongly preferred)

• Experience with medical documentation review, QA, or compliance tracking

• Strong English communication skills (spoken and written)

• High attention to detail and strong organizational skills

• Strong computer proficiency (Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, EMR systems)

• Ability to work independently in a remote, fast-paced environment

• Ability to work after-hours, evenings, and weekends (U.S. Pacific Time)

• Reliable high-speed internet and professional remote workspace



Preferred



• Direct Hospice QA or compliance experience

• Experience with Home Health/Hospice EMR systems (e.g., Kinnser/WellSky, Axxess, Hospice MD, Homecare Homebase)

• Clinical background (RN & USRN, LVN, Medical Assistant, or allied health) but USRN is much preferred.

• Familiarity with hospice regulations and documentation standards



How to Apply



Please submit a short cover letter/resume highlighting your relevant experience and include your answers to the questions below:



Describe your experience in hospice or home health, including your role, duration, and responsibilities.



Do you have experience with quality assurance, chart audits, or compliance tracking? Please explain.



How many years of experience do you have in Hospice or Home Health?



What EMR systems have you used (e.g., Kinnser/WellSky, Axxess, Hospice MD, Homecare Homebase)?



Describe your experience reviewing or managing medical documentation (orders, certifications, care plans, etc.).

s that need my attention or decision, any open items that are due or overdue, and anything flagged from the previous day that wasn't resolved. This brief replaces the need for me to check everything myself.

- Open loop tracking — maintain a live tracker of every outstanding item across all ventures. Chase items proactively. If something has been sitting open for more than 5 days with no update, flag it without being asked.

- Light research tasks as assigned



**Rental Property Support (JTK Rentals)**



- Airbnb guest coordination — responding to inquiries and handling guest communication using templates I provide

- Some guest calls when needed — I'll train you on what to say

- Booking calendar management — keep availability current

- Follow-up on property-related correspondence



**Cross-Portfolio Admin**



- Document tracking — flag and chase unsigned DocuSign items

- Vendor and professional follow-ups across all active ventures

- Regulation and compliance research — as new markets are evaluated for expansion (parking enforcement, franchise territories, rental markets), you will research local licensing, permit, and compliance requirements and compile findings into structured trackers

- Ad hoc tasks as the portfolio evolves



**The ventures you will support across all of the above:**



- **Knockout Cap** — DTC e-commerce brand (migraine ice cap)

- **Breakwater Operations** — offshore staffing company serving US property managers

- **SwiftBoot** — vehicle immobilization / parking enforcement (Phoenix, expanding)

- **ULC** — wellness franchise (3 Arizona territories)

- **JTK Rentals** — short-term and mid-term rentals (Arizona, Texas, Mexico)



You will not run any of these businesses. You will handle the administrative and operational layer that keeps them moving.



## What You Will NOT Do



- Run paid ads or manage social media

- Handle bookkeeping or finances

- Manage any of my other teams (separate people handle those)



## What "Flexible" Actually Means in This Role



I want to be direct so there are no surprises after you're hired.



I currently run 5 ventures. More will launch. Each new venture may add responsibilities to your plate. Here are examples of the kinds of things that could come up as the portfolio grows:



- A new DTC brand launches — you help coordinate supplier communication, track orders, manage customer service
s

- A new market opens for SwiftBoot — you research local regulations, licensing requirements, and key contacts

- A new franchise territory is added — you manage the administrative onboarding process

- A new rental property comes online — you set up the Airbnb listing, manage the calendar, handle guest comms

- A new tea
mber joins — you help onboard them, share SOPs, make sure they have what they need



None of these require a specialist. They require someone organized, resourceful, and willing to figure things out. That is what this role is. If a task falls within the administrative and operational layer of running a business — it is in scope.



## What We're Looking For



**Required:**



- Excellent written English — clear, professional, concise

- Strong organizational skills — nothing falls through the cracks

- Proactive communicator — you flag issues before they become problems

- Comfortable working across multiple businesses simultaneously

- Reliable internet and distraction-free work environment

- Available for some overlap with US Mountain Time (Arizona — no DST)



**Nice to have:**



- Prior Airbnb or short-term rental experience

- Experience supporting a business owner or entrepreneur

- Familiarity with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive)



## Tools You'll Use



- Gmail and Google Calendar — primary inbox and scheduling tools

- Google Drive — shared documents, trackers, SOPs

- Notion — your task tracker, open loop database, and operations hub. You will use Notion daily. If you have not used Notion before, you must be willing to learn it on Day 1.

- Airbnb host platform — I'll train you

- Slack — daily brief and all communications with Jojo

- WhatsApp — urgent flags only



## How We Work



- Tasks come via Slack and Notion

- Daily brief sent every morning by 9 AM PHT — calendar,
 flags, open items, anything urgent

- Weekly summary every Friday

- I don't micromanage — I expect you to own your work and flag when something needs me

- "Use your judgment on edge cases" is how most instructions end

- You are working across multiple active businesses simultaneously — this requires you to be organized, methodical, and proactive every single day without prompting



## Compensation & Terms



- $250–300/month depending on experience

- Paid via Wise, bi-weekly

- 30-day trial period — mutual, no penalty to end on either side

- Rate review at 60 days and 6 months based on performance



## Growth Path



This role is designed to grow. Here is what that looks like in practice:



**Months 1–2 — Foundation**



Personal inbox, calendar, open loops, basic rental coordination. You learn how I operate, what good looks like, and how to communicate the way I need.



**Months 3–6 — Expanded Scope**



As you prove your execution, you take on more. This may include supporting additional ventures in the portfolio, coordinating between tea
mbers across different businesses, and managing more complex tasks with less direction.



**Months 6–12 — Portfolio Operator**



At this stage you are not a VA. You are a portfolio operations coordinator. You are proactively managing my operational load across multiple ventures, onboarding new tools and systems as they're introduced, and flagging problems before I know they exist.



**Month 12+ — Senior Operator**



As new ventures launch, experienced operators in this role take on broader responsibility — potentially overseeing other VAs, managing cross-venture coordination, and operating with significant autonomy.



The person who earns this trajectory will not be the person who waits to be told what to do. It will be the person who reads the company, understands the priorities, and acts on them. 



There will be room to grow with time-



 ## How to Apply



Your application must include:

title: Lead Generation & CRM Virtual Assistant
description:
01  ABOUT US



We are a vehicle immobilization company launching in Phoenix, Arizona. We place windshield devices on unauthorized vehicles at apartment complexes, HOAs, and retail centers — as an alternative to towing. Drivers pay $150 online to release their vehicle without needing a tow truck.



We are a small, fast-moving team. The COO runs sales and field operations. You will be her support system — making sure she walks into every day with a full, prepped pipeline and zero administrative chaos.



02  THE ROLE



This is a lead generation and CRM management role. You are NOT a caller. You are the person who makes our callers effective.



Your single most important job every day:



Deliver 50 fully researched, tagged, and loaded leads into GoHighLevel CRM before 8:30am Phoenix time (MST) every weekday.

30 leads go into the COO's call queue. 20 leads go into the Ops Supervisor's call queue.

No name found on the property = the lead does not go into the human queue.

Every lead must have: property name, address, manager name, phone number, source tag, and profile tag.



03  DAILY TASKS



BEFORE 8:30AM PHOENIX TIME — Non-Negotiable



• Research and load 50 prepped leads into GoHighLevel CRM

• For each lead: find manager name via LinkedIn or Google, verify phone number, assign correct source profile tag (Profile 1–4), assign queue tag (QUEUE-MARKCHELE or QUEUE-KATIE)

• Any lead without a verified manager name goes into the AI Voice cold pool, not the human call queue



DURING THE DAY — Ongoing Support



• Monitor cold
 inbox for warm replies — flag and escalate within 1 hour

• Log call outcomes in GHL after each calling session (COO will brief you)

• Send 20–30 LinkedIn connection requests per day from the COO's account to property managers in Phoenix

• Mine Google Reviews daily for properties with parking complaints — these become high-priority leads



WEEKLY — AI Voice Pool & Reporting



• Load 300–500 cold contacts into the GHL AI Voice pool every week (name + phone only, no research required)

• Replenish the AI pool when it drops below 200 contacts

• Deliver Jojo's strategic call list (10–15 stalled/high-value contacts) every Wednesday by end of day

• Send Friday pipeline report: leads loaded, pipeline movement, queue status,
 performance



04  WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO



Be clear on your boundaries. This keeps you, the team, and the company safe.



• You do NOT make outbound sales calls (Month 1)

• You do NOT attend or schedule demos on your own

• You do NOT approve refunds or respond to driver disputes

• You do NOT contact properties that are currently in active negotiation unless instructed

• You do NOT make decisions — you flag, log, and escalate



05  REQUIREMENTS



Must-Haves



• GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM experience — you must have used it before, not just heard of it

• LinkedIn research skills — you must be able to find a property manager's name and verify it in under 5 minutes

• Excellent written English — your tagging notes, log entries, and messages to the team must be clear and professional

• Reliable internet and computer — this role requires fast, consistent performance every morning

• Available weekdays during Phoenix morning hours (8:00–9:00am MST minimum overlap)

• Detail-oriented — one wrong tag in the wrong queue costs the team a conversation



Nice-to-Haves



• Experience with Instantly or other cold
 tools

• Familiarity with 
 or similar lead databases

• Background in real estate, property management, or B2B lead generation

• Experience supporting a sales team or SDR function



06  SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION



Item Detail

Pay $300/month (part-time launch)

Hours ~20 hours/week to start

Month 2 Path Full-time ($500–$600/month) if KPIs are met in Month 1

Schedule Weekdays. Must be available for the 8:00–9:00am Phoenix MST window daily.

Payment Weekly or bi-weekly via your preferred method

Start Date As soon as possible — we are ready to move



07  HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED



These are the numbers we track weekly. They determine your Month 2 path.



KPI Target

Leads delivered before 8:30am 50/day, 5 days/week — no exceptions

Manager name found rate 90%+ of leads in human queues have verified manager names

AI voice pool level Never drops below 200 contacts

Warm reply flag time Within 1 hour of reply hitting inbox

Friday report delivered Every Friday by 5:00pm Phoenix time



08  HOW TO APPLY — READ THIS CAREFULLY



Applications that do not answer all three screening questions will be deleted without review.

Do not send a generic cover letter. Answer the questions below specifically and concisely.

We will respond to qualified applicants within 48 hours.



Answer all three of the following questions in your application:



Question 1: Have you used GoHighLevel CRM before? If yes, describe specifically what you built or managed inside GHL (pipelines, automations, tags, contacts). If no, tell us what CRM you have used and what you did with it.

Question 2: We need 50 researched leads in our CRM before 8:30am Phoenix time every weekday. Walk us through exactly how you would find and verify the name and phone number of the property manager for an apartment complex in Phoenix, Arizona using LinkedIn and Google. Step by step.

Question 3: What time is 8:30am Phoenix, Arizona (MST) in your local time? Are you available and online at that time every weekday?



? Answer all 3 questions specifically — generic answers will be filtered out

? Keep your answers concise and factual — we are not looking for sales pitches

? Do not apply if you cannot be online at 8:30am Phoenix time on weekdays

? Do not apply if you have not used GHL or another CRM in a real work setting

API Integration: Connect AI agents with external APIs to extend their capabilities, such as payment gateways, third-party services, or cloud-based applications.

Maintain and Update Prompts: Regularly review and update prompts to reflect evolving needs and maintain relevance.

Test AI Agents: Conduct rigorous testing on virtual assistants to ensure they operate smoothly and effectively, identifying and resolving potential issues.

Optimize AI Performance: Regularly evaluate the performance of AI agents, fine-tuning their algorithms for better results and user experience.

Error Handling: Design and implement error management systems to handle edge cases and unexpected inputs from users.

Build Interactive Interfaces: Create user-friendly interfaces and conversational flows for AI agents, ensuring they are intuitive and efficient for end-users.

Develop Multi-channel AI Assistants: Ensure that AI agents can function across different communication channels (website,
, social media, etc.).

Personalization of AI Responses: Create personalized experiences for users based on their preferences, behaviors, and interactions.



6. Monitoring and Maintenance



Ongoing Monitoring: Continuously monitor AI agents for performance, user interactions, and system errors.

Analytics & Reporting: Generate performance reports on AI interactions, analyzing user engagement and the effectiveness of responses.

Troubleshooting: Quickly resolve any issues or bugs reported by users or internal teams.



7. Security and Privacy



Data Privacy: Ensure that AI agents comply with privacy and data security regulations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) when processing user data.

Secure Communication: Implement security protocols for all interactions between users and the AI agents to safeguard sensitive information.



8. Documentation and Training



Create Documentation: Develop comprehensive documentation on the design, functionality, and maintenance of the AI virtual assistants.

Provide Internal Training: Train internal teams on how to interact with, manage, and optimize AI systems.



9. Collaboration and Communication



Work with Cross-functional Teams: Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders to align AI systems with business goals.

Client Communication: Communicate directly with clients to understand their needs and provide tailored AI solutions.



10. Research and Development



Stay Up-to-date on AI Trends: Continuously research the latest developments in AI technologies, tools, and platforms to bring innovative solutions to the organization.

Experiment with New Technologies: Test and implement emerging AI frameworks, platforms, and tools to enhance capabilities.



Desired Experience and Skills



Experience: At least 3 years of experience in AI development, with specific expertise in virtual assistants, agents, and prompt engineering.

Platforms: Strong experience with Claude, GPT-based models (e.g., GPT-4), and other AI platforms such as Dialogflow, Rasa, or IBM Watson.

Programming: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, or other languages commonly used in AI development.

AI Frameworks: Familiarity with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and OpenAI’s API.

Problem-solving: Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to think critically when optimizing and troubleshooting AI systems.

title: Creator Revenue Operations Coordinator (Repurposing & Communication)
description:

Role Objective



Drive revenue growth for creators and the Company’s Network by managing repurposing, communication, and operational workflows that ensure content is consistently distributed, campaigns are executed reliably, and opportunities are captured without delay.



This role enables creators to focus on producing content while ensuring the operational engine behind their business runs smoothly and generates measurable results.



This is not an administrative role.

This is a revenue infrastructure role responsible for execution, consistency, and visibility across creator operations.



This role is part of our long-term infrastructure.

We are building a team of Revenue Operations Coordinators who can support multiple creators across the network while maintaining reliability, speed, and performance.



Why This Role Exists



We are building a repeatable operational system that supports:



Creator revenue growth

Content distribution consistency

Brand partnership execution

Campaign reliability

Network scalability



Without this role:

Content goes unpublished

s go unanswered

With this role:

Communication stays responsive

Campaigns run on schedule

Revenue opportunities are captured

Operations scale reliably



Primary Responsibilities

Responsibilities include:

Repurpose creator content across platforms

Monitor creator
 inboxes

Missed
s often mean missed revenue.

title: Compliance Administrator — Protection Advice Checks
description:
We are a UK-based financial services firm looking for a meticulous compliance administrator to support our protection advice quality assurance process. You will be reviewing real client files and checking that our advisers meet FCA regulatory standards — accuracy and attention to detail are non-negotiable.



Before applying, please read carefully. This role has flexible hours — you manage your own schedule. However, you will need to be available for at least 2–3 hours overlap with UK afternoons (roughly 1pm–5pm GMT/BST) to contact advisers by
 and WhatsApp. 



Applications that do not follow the instructions below will not be reviewed.





What you will do

Review protection advice files for suitability, justification, and FCA compliance

Verify that advisers complete the full sales process — fact-find, needs analysis, product disclosure, and documentation

Check that Consumer Duty requirements are met, including vulnerable-customer considerations

Validate that all mandatory documents are present: SoA, IDD, disclosures, affordability checks, and replacement business evidence

Log all findings and scores accurately in our compliance system

Chase advisers for corrections via
 and WhatsApp, and track remediation to completion

Identify recurring issues or process gaps and report them to the Compliance Manager

Maintain organised, audit-ready compliance records



What we are looking for

Strong attention to detail — you notice what others miss

Experience in compliance, quality assurance, document checking, or financial services administration

Comfortable cross-referencing documents and spotting inconsistencies

Reliable, self-managing, and meets deadlines without chasing

Confident written communicator in English

Available for 2–3 hours of UK afternoon overlap most weekdays





Application screening — you must complete all of these to be considered



Answer in your cover message. Keep answers concise.



Q1 Describe a task where you had to check documents carefully for errors or missing information. What did you look for, and what happened when you found an issue?

Q2 You have been chasing someone to correct a file for five days with no response. What steps do you take?

Q3 (attention check) Start your first line with the phrase "UK compliance ready" — then continue your answer normally. 





Applications missing this phrase will not be read.





Nice to have



Experience with UK financial services, insurance, or protection products

Familiarity with FCA regulations or Consumer Duty principles

Previous remote compliance or QA work with a UK or European employer





Pay progression

$3 / hr Month 1 — trial period

$4 / hr Month 2 onwards



Reviewed After 3–5 months based on performance



We are looking for someone to grow with us long-term. Pay reviews are based on the quality and consistency of your work.



What we offer



Fully remote — work from home on a flexible schedule

Stable long-term role with a specialist UK firm

Clear processes and ongoing support from the Compliance Manager

Regular feedback and a genuine path to higher pay

title: Operations Systems Architect
description:
Operations Systems Architect 

Project-Based Role | Multifamily Property Operations | KPI Scorecards | Systems Design 



We own and operate multifamily apartment communities in Dallas, Texas. We are looking for a project-based Operations Systems Architect to help us design a practical operating system for our multifamily apartment business. 



This role is for someone who can understand how our business works, identify the right KPIs, design weekly scorecards, recommend the right software/tools, and create a system our team can actually use consistently. We are not just looking for a software builder. We need someone who understands operations, accountability, team performance, and how to turn daily work into measurable results. 



Our goal is to improve how we track performance, hold tea
mbers accountable, and review results on a consistent weekly basis. 



What We Need Help With:

- The person we hire should help us design: 

- A company-level scorecard 

- Property-level scorecards 

- Role-based KPIs 

- Weekly meeting/reporting structure 

- Daily or weekly tracking process 

- Software/tool recommendations 

- A simple workflow for data entry and reporting 

- Training process for our assistant or internal team 



We want the final system to be simple, practical, and easy enough for our team to use without overcomplicating daily operations. 



Key Responsibilities:

- Review how our current operations work 

- Understand the roles in our property management team 

- Recommend meaningful KPIs for each role 

- Design weekly scorecards tied to actual performance 

- Create a structure for weekly management meetings, similar to EOS/L10 style meetings 

- Recommend the best tools or software for tracking KPIs and tasks 

- Help determine whether Airtable, ClickUp, another tool, or a simpler system is the right fit 

- Map out where data should come from, such as ResMan, HappyCo, spreadsheets, or manual inputs 

- Create a practical process for maintaining the system 

- Train our assistant or team on how to update and prepare reports 



Required Skills:

- Strong understanding of business operations 

- Ability to design practical KPIs and scorecards 

- Experience building accountability systems 

- Experience with weekly reporting or management meeting structures 

- Ability to simplify messy operations into clear processes 

- Experience recommending or building systems using tools such as Airtable, ClickUp, 
, Asana, Notion, Smartsheet, Excel, or similar platforms 

- Ability to document processes clearly 

- Ability to train a tea
mber to maintain the system 



Ideal Candidate Background:

You may be a good fit if you have experience as a: 

- Operations Manager 

- Operations Consultant 

- Business Systems Consultant 

- Airtable / ClickUp / 
 / Asana / Notion builder with operations experience 

- KPI or dashboard designer 

- Consultant or analyst with strong systems thinking 

- AI consultant with strong systems adoption 



Relevant industry experience may include: 

- Property management 

- Real estate operations 

- Logistics 

- Call centers 

- SaaS operations 

- Service businesses 

- Field operations 

- Multi-location operations 

- Great Game of Business familiarity 

*Strong operations and systems design experience is a major plus. 



How To Apply:

Please send the following: 

- A brief summary of your operations or systems experience

- Examples of KPI, scorecard, dashboard, or operations systems you have designed

- Software/tools you have experience with

- Your experience with weekly management meetings, EOS/L10 meetings, or accountability systems

- Your proposed approach for this project

- Your hourly rate or project-based pricing

- Your availability for Zoom calls

title: Tenancy Management Admin – Full Time – Remote
description:
Job Description

We are looking for a highly reliable, detail-oriented, and proactive Tenancy Manager Admin to join our team full time on a remote basis.



We manage a portfolio of residential properties in central London and need someone who is precise, organised, and able to handle important administrative tasks without mistakes. This is NOT a generic VA role. We need someone who can work carefully, follow procedures exactly, and take real ownership of their work.



This role involves handling sensitive tasks such as rent tracking, tenant administration, contract checks, move-in coordination, landlord and tenant communications, and general property management support (problem solving). Accuracy is absolutely essential.



Main Responsibilities



Update and maintain rent ledgers accurately

Track rent payments, arrears, and outstanding balances

Prepare and check tenancy documents, guarantor documents, and contract packs

Ensure all required documents and payments are complete before move-ins

Draft clear and professional
s to tenants, landlords, and contractors

Solve and deal with maintenance issues through our trusted contractors

Follow up on maintenance issues and confirm completion

Keep spreadsheets, records, and internal systems fully accurate and up to date

Report any issue, discrepancy immediately and handle general admin tasks

Follow procedures carefully and double/triple-check all important tasks before completion



Requirements



Previous experience in property management, real estate admin, leasing support, or a similar role (Uk or US preferred but not essential)

Excellent written and spoken English

Very strong attention to detail

Highly organised and able to manage multiple tasks carefully

Able to follow instructions and procedures exactly

Good problem-solving skills and common sense

Comfortable using spreadsheets,
, and online systems

Able to work independently and take ownership of tasks

Honest, reliable, and consistent, and able to work under pressure



Important

This role requires a high level of accuracy. Mistakes in this position can have financial and operational consequences. We are looking for someone who naturally double-checks their work and is able to think outside the box and takes pride in getting things right.



What We Offer

Full-time remote role

Opportunity to grow within the company

Performance-based company bonus

2 weeks Paid holidays after 1 year of continuous work

Long-term opportunity for the right candidate



Working Hours

Applicants must be available to work during UK business hours



Salary

Competitive, depending on experience and suitability.

Performance bonus



Application Process

To apply, please send:



Your CV

A short introduction about your experience in property management or similar work

Examples of the types of admin/property tasks you have handled

Confirmation of your availability for full-time work

Confirmation of whether you currently work for any other clients



Please note that shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a practical test to assess accuracy, judgment, and attention

to detail.



Please note: to confirm attention to detail, copy and paste this exact sentence at the top of your application: “I understand that accuracy is essential in tenancy management.”

title: Video Editor (FOR META ADS) - SKILLED ONLY $7 hour
description:

We want someone who can think creatively, work fast, and deliver performance driven ads with minimal input.



This is a long term opportunity with strong potential to grow into a full time role if the work is good.



What you will do

You should be able to handle the full creative process:

* Source relevant video footage

* Generate video footage using AI when needed

* Edit complete video ads for Meta

* Create strong hooks, pacing, ad structure, and overall flow

* Turn briefings and competitor inspiration into original, high converting creatives

* Strong experience with video editing for Meta ads

* Good understanding of direct response advertising

* Experience with ecommerce creatives

* Experience using AI tools for video generation, enhancement, or support

* Strong English communication skills

* Fast, reliable, and easy to work with

* Someone who can take ownership and move quickly without constant back and forth



Communication

Good communication is very important to us.

* We communicate mainly through Slack

Delivery time

Fast turnaround is a hard requirement.

Trial assignment

The best candidate will be hired.



Salary

$7 per hour



Long term potential

If your work is strong, this can become a full time position with ongoing work and a lot of growth potential.



To apply, please send

* Your best examples of Meta or ecommerce video ads

title: Video Editor for UGC Repurposing (Trading Brand)
description:
Video Editor for UGC Repurposing (Trading Brand)



Type: Full-time / Part-time (open to both)

Compensation: Based on experience



About Us



We are a fast-growing trading brand looking to maximise the value of our existing content library. We have built a large collection of UGC footage that was originally created for another brand, and we are now repurposing that content into fresh, high-performing creatives for a different trading brand.



We are looking for a video editor who understands performance content — someone who can take existing footage and make it feel new again.



If you understand hooks, pacing, retention, and what makes people stop scrolling, we want to hear from you.



What You Will Be Doing



* Create realistic AI voiceovers based on provided scripts

* Repurpose existing raw UGC footage into fresh video ads

* Re-edit content with new angles and messaging

* Create attention-grabbing ads optimized for TikTok and Meta

* Produce 3 different hook variations for every project

* Add clean and accurate subtitles with strong pacing throughout the video

* Deliver videos in 9:16 format (1080x1920)

* Make revisions quickly based on feedback



What We Are Looking For



* Minimum 1 year of experience editing short-form content

* Strong understanding of TikTok and Meta ad creatives

* Experience with CapCut, Adobe Premiere, or DaVinci Resolve

* Experience using AI voiceover tools

* Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, and retention

* Ability to make existing footage feel fresh and engaging

* Strong attention to detail

* Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines

* Good English communication skills



How We Work



We provide:



* Scripts

* Existing raw footage

* Creative direction

* Examples and references



Your job is simple: turn existing content into fresh ads that feel native and drive results.



Editors who perform well will receive access to our full content library, creating an opportunity for a steady workflow and long-term collaboration.



How To Apply (Read Carefully)



We do not hire based on portfolios alone.



To be considered for this role, you must complete a short paid test project. We care more about your ability to create high-performing content than a list of previous work.



Step 1 – Access the project files



Inside the folder you will find the footage, script, and instructions needed to complete the test project:







Step 2 – Create the test video



Requirements:



* Create a realistic AI voiceover using the provided script

* Use the provided footage to create a fresh, attention-grabbing edit

* Create 3 different hook versions

* Add clean and accurate subtitles

* Deliver in 9:16 format (1080x1920)



Step 3 – Submit your application



Send us:



* Your completed video

* A short explanation of your creative choices and approach



We will review your edit to determine whether you are a good fit for our team.



We are not looking for someone who can simply make videos look good. We are looking for someone who understands what keeps people watching and what drives results.

title: Online Math/Science Teacher(Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.



Qualifications



Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency
