title: Senior AWS Architect to Pair with Lead Developer on Short Production Migration (Supabase to AWS)
description:
We are a pre-launch, AI-native SaaS company building enterprise-grade infrastructure on AWS before our first customer goes live. We have completed our architecture design (detailed spec available under NDA) and need a senior AWS architect to pair with our lead developer for 3 weeks, 30 hours per week (90 hours total), starting immediately.



This is NOT a "build it for us" engagement. You will pair with our lead developer Mark, who will own the system after you leave. Your role is to validate the design, accelerate the AWS Landing Zone foundation, and mentor through architecture decisions. We move fast. You should too.



Product context (non-confidential):

- Pre-launch, multi-tenant SaaS targeting regulated EU markets, with planned UK and US expansion

- High-throughput transactional system requiring sub-200ms latency, zero data loss, multi-region resilience

- Stack: React Native (Expo) client with offline sync; Node.js/NestJS backend; PostgreSQL system of record

- Strict EU data residency: eu-north-1 primary, eu-west-1 DR

- Compliance posture: SOC 2 Type II readiness, EU fiscal/regulatory requirements, enterprise procurement-ready

- Pre-launch state means we are redesigning AWS-native from the ground up, not lifting-and-shifting



Scope of Work (3 weeks, 30 hours per week, 90 hours total):



Phase A — Design validation and high-risk spikes (Week 1)

- Review existing AWS-native platform design spec and challenge assumptions

- Pair on minimal Aurora PostgreSQL cluster setup in non-prod, including custom cluster parameter group (pg_cron, pg_stat_statements, audit logging, statement timeouts)

- Validate Aurora Global Database scaffolding (eu-north-1 primary, eu-west-1 ready) created early to avoid destructive conversion later

- Pair on minimal Cognito User Pool spike and identity mapping pattern

- Validate request-scoped DB context pattern (transaction-scoped set_config for tenant isolation) with RDS Proxy

- Evaluate ECS Express Mode vs custom L3 Fargate construct and make a recommendation for the foundation phase

- Confirm AppSync Events compliance scoping (ISO 27017/27018 in-scope check)

- Document Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) for every non-obvious choice



Phase B — Landing Zone and foundation (Weeks 2 to 3)

- AWS Organizations + Control Tower setup with five accounts: management, prod, non-prod, log-archive, audit-security

- Identity Center and permission sets

- CDK (TypeScript) app scaffold with cdk-nag passing on suppressions only with documented justification

- Network architecture: VPC, public/private/isolated subnets across 2+ AZs, NAT, VPC endpoints day one

- ECS Fargate cluster, ALB with WAF, ECR with lifecycle policies

- Aurora Global Database cluster (writer + Serverless v2 readers), custom cluster parameter group, RDS Proxy, Performance Insights, Enhanced Monitoring

- S3 buckets with Object Lock for fiscal-grade immutable storage, CloudFront for SPA hosting

- CloudTrail (org trail to log-archive account), AWS Config, Security Hub, GuardDuty

- Customer-managed KMS keys per scope with rotation policies; Multi-Region keys where DR requires

- Secrets Manager with rotation

- CI/CD via GitHub Actions with OIDC (no long-lived AWS keys)

- AWS Budgets and Cost Anomaly Detection

- Cross-region backup copy to dedicated backup vault in compliance-locked mode



Deliverables:

- Working CDK foundation deployed to non-prod

- Aurora cluster validated with parameter group, RDS Proxy, and the DB context pattern proven against a real RLS test fixture

- One online and one simulated offline transactional command working end-to-end in non-prod

- Architecture Decision Records covering all major choices

- Runbooks for: deploy rollback, Aurora failover, secret rotation, backup restore

- Backup restore drill executed (proof that backups actually restore, not just that they exist)

- Final handoff document: how Mark extends this foundation for subsequent phases (auth, RLS, offline sync, fiscal, integrations, observability)



Required experience:

- 7+ years building and operating production SaaS on AWS, not enterprise IT migrations

- Hands-on production experience with Aurora PostgreSQL Global Database at scale, including parameter groups, RDS Proxy, and Performance Insights

- Strong on AWS CDK in TypeScript; cdk-nag familiarity

- Production experience with ECS Fargate, ALB, WAF, Cognito, SQS, EventBridge, S3 Object Lock, KMS, Secrets Manager

- AWS Organizations and Control Tower setup experience

- Multi-region architecture experience with explicit RTO/RPO targets

- Strong on observability fundamentals: CloudWatch, X-Ray, OpenTelemetry (ADOT)

- Background in fintech, payments, POS, e-commerce, or other regulated transactional SaaS strongly preferred

- Comfortable pairing and mentoring; able to write Architecture Decision Records that explain the why, not just the what

- Startup pace, not enterprise governance pace



Out of scope for this engagement (handled by us or in later phases):

- Application code beyond foundation validation spikes

- Auth/authorization implementation beyond the Cognito + identity mapping spike

- Offline sync logic, fiscal processing, vendor integrations

- Production cutover (no live customers yet)

- SOC 2 audit prep beyond foundation evidence collection



Engagement details:

- Duration: 3 weeks, starting immediately

- Commitment: 30 hours per week (90 hours total)

- Working style: Pair programming and review with our lead developer (Philippines timezone), async ADRs, daily sync calls

- NDA required before access to detailed architecture spec

- Potential continuation: Part-time retainer (10 to 15 hours per month) for ongoing architecture review through subsequent phases



To apply, share:

1. A short note on relevant production AWS foundation builds you have led, especially involving Aurora Global Database and Control Tower

2. The largest transactional system you have architected on AWS, with concrete numbers (transactions per second, p99 latency, regions, data volume)

3. Your CDK experience with a public or shareable code sample if possible

4. Your hourly rate and confirmed availability to start this week

We need someone who can think deeply, work carefully, and get real quality out of their hours.



Our store is already live and we are actively trying to get the cleanest possible Google Merchant Center setup and approval path. We need someone who can help us review, fix, and improve everything properly so the store is as safe, compliant, and stable as possible for Google.



What you will work on

Your role will include work such as:



* reviewing our Shopify store for GMC-related risk points

* checking our Google Merchant Center thoroughly

* reviewing a detailed GMC checklist point by point

* identifying anything that is:



* incomplete

* inconsistent

* risky

* misleading

* weak for Google trust/compliance

* fixing issues in:



* product data

* attributes

* feed setup

* sync issues

* policy pages

* trust signals

* business information consistency

* landing page consistency

* Shopify settings / theme output where relevant

* reviewing how products, attributes, and website pages align between:



* Shopify

* feed app(s)

* Google Merchant Center

* helping us make the store as GMC-safe and approval-ready as possible



Important

We are not looking for someone who only writes reports, gives generic advice, or repeats policy help pages.



We want someone who can:



* review deeply

* find real issues

* explain clearly

* implement fixes

* work with urgency and quality



If you are someone who only checks things superficially, this is not the right role.



What we are specifically looking for

You should ideally have strong experience with:



Shopify



* product setup

* collections

* navigation

* policy pages

* theme settings

* product pages

* app interactions

* store trust / UX review

* fixing inconsistencies



Google Merchant Center



* product disapprovals

* feed errors

* missing attributes

* policy-related restrictions

* website quality issues

* misrepresentation-related reviews

* diagnostics and issue checking

* preparing a store/feed for approval



Feed / product data / sync



* attribute mapping

* apparel requirements

* availability / inventory sync

* pricing consistency

* feed-to-landing-page consistency

* issues caused by product pushes / imports / updates



GMC checklist / compliance mindset

You must be comfortable going through a detailed checklist and checking everything carefully and one by one, not loosely.



The type of person we want

We are looking for someone who is:



* highly detail-oriented

* careful and precise

* honest and direct

* technically capable

* proactive

* strong in communication

* responsive

* able to work independently

* able to explain what is wrong, what was fixed, and what still needs work



We value quality per hour very highly.

That means we care much more about real useful output than empty activity.



Daily work expectations

We want someone who can work seriously and with focus.



You must be willing to:



* track hours clearly

* send clean updates

* communicate blockers quickly

* stay structured

* move with urgency when needed



What to include in your application

Please do not send a generic application.



When you apply, include:



1. your experience with Shopify

2. your experience with Google Merchant Center

3. whether you have worked on:



* misrepresentation issues

* website needs improvement issues

* suspensions

* product disapprovals

4. examples of what types of GMC / Shopify issues you have personally fixed

5. whether you are comfortable reviewing a full GMC checklist point by point

6. whether you can also implement fixes, not only audit/report

7. your hourly rate

8. your availability per day / week

9. how fast you can start



Final note

We are looking for someone who can become genuinely valuable to the team, but right now the first priority is simple:



help us review and improve the store and GMC setup properly, thoroughly, and with real quality.



If that sounds like you, apply with a serious and specific response.

title: Bookkeeper with QBO experience
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

We are looking for a detail-oriented Bookkeeper to oversee the organization's financial record-keeping to ensure the business can make sound financial decisions. This position will be responsible for producing monthly financial reports, maintaining an adequate accounting record system, and managing a comprehensive set of controls, budgets, and forecasting to mitigate risks. The Bookkeeper will play a key role in enhancing the accuracy of the company’s reported financial results and ensuring those results comply with generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) and bookkeeping principles and procedures. This position will report directly to the Finance Manager.





This position is 100% remote.





ABOUT CARDONE VENTURES

Our mission is to help business owners achieve their personal, professional, and financial goals through the growth of their businesses. We work in dozens of verticals and provide strategic business guidance through courses, live events, partnerships, and investments. Our core values are the backbone of our business and guide our hiring process: we are inspirational, disciplined, accountable, transparent, aligned, and results-oriented. This company operates nationally and is growing by the day.

Wondering what it's like to work here? Come check this:


/watch?v=PIIv7sYj1Ns

- Timely and accurate delivery of monthly financial reports, reconciliations, and compliance filings

- Organized and auditable accounting systems with well-maintained digital records and controls

- Budgets and forecasts are submitted on time with clear variance analysis and actionable insights

- All payables, debt obligations, and tax filings are completed without delays or errors

- Trusted financial insights that support business decisions and reflect a strong understanding of GAAP principles





OBJECTIVES

- Develop a documented system of accounting policies and procedures

- Develop professionally by remaining aware of new state and federal regulations, participating in educational opportunities, and reading professional publications

- Ensure that monthly bank and credit card reconciliations are completed

- Ensure that required debt payments (company credit cards, loans, or lines of credit) are paid on a timely basis

- Develop and maintain an orderly accounting filing system (digital)

- Manage the production of the annual budget and forecasts

- Calculate variances from the budget and report significant issues to ownership

- Calculate and issue financial and operating metrics

- Coordinate the preparation and compilation of year-end reporting and financial statements

- Report and file state sales and use tax

- Perform other duties as assigned



COMPETENCIES

- Demonstrates proficiency with QuickBooks, XERO or other accounting software, MS Office Suite, Adobe, Windows, DocuSign, Google Suite

- Proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment of change and growth

- Possesses strong written and verbal communication skills, clearly communicating by phone or in person with tea
mbers

- Ability to successfully maintain a positive attitude while working in a team environment with competing priorities

- Possesses outstanding organizational and administrative skills



EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

- Bachelor’s degree in accounting and finance, or equivalent business experience

- Minimum 3 years of progressive experience in bookkeeping

- Experience working with multiple legal entities under a legal umbrella

- Experience with financial reporting requirements



PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer

Company: Fresh Paint Marketing LLC

Location: Remote

Core Hours: 9:00am–5:00pm AEST (Monday–Friday)

Compensation: $700–$900USD/month base + performance bonuses (up to $400/month)

Reporting To: Eral Kadrija (Founder & CEO)





About the Role



As a Media Buyer, you will be responsible for launching, managing, and optimising paid advertising campaigns for our clients across
 Ads and Google Ads. Your mission is simple: drive consistent lead volume while hitting strong CPL targets.



This is local lead generation, not complex eCommerce. You’ll be running straightforward campaigns (radius targeting, lead forms, direct response) at scale — typically 40+ active campaigns — so efficiency and organisation matter.





Key Responsibilities



Campaign Setup & Launch

• Build and launch new campaigns for newly ---------- clients across
 Ads

• Configure targeting, budgets, creatives, lead forms, tracking, and campaign structure



Daily Campaign Management

• Monitor performance daily and make smart optimisations

• Adjust budgets, pause underperformers, and scale winning ads

• Maintain clean account structure and ensure campaigns run smoothly



Cost Per Lead (CPL) Optimisation

• Continuously optimise to reduce CPL and increase lead volume

• Identify inefficiencies and implement performance improvements quickly



A/B Testing

• Test ad creatives, copy, audiences, placements, and campaign angles

• Use testing insights to improve results and prevent creative fatigue



Reporting

• Track and report key metrics such as CPL, CTR, CPC, frequency, conversion volume

• Provide clear updates to the internal team and support client reporting needs



Troubleshooting & Problem Solving

• Diagnose and fix underperformance (low CTR, high CPL, learning limitations)

• Resolve ad rejections, policy issues, and technical hiccups efficiently



Collaboration

• Work closely with the Ad Creative Team (images/videos) and CSMs (client requests + feedback)

• Collaborate with other media buyers to share insights and improve systems





What Success Looks Like (KPIs)



We measure success by results, not hours. Here’s what “winning” looks like:

• Average CPL: $35-45

• Campaign Load: 40+ campaigns managed

• Ad Approval Rate: ? 95%

• Internal Response Time: < 2>

• Client Retention Support: Contribute to 11% churn by delivering consistent performance



If you consistently hit these targets, you can earn $900–$1,400+ per month (base + bonuses).



Who You’ll Work With



You’ll report directly to Eral Kadrija (Founder & CEO) and collaborate with:

• Customer Success Managers (CSMs): handle client communication and relay requests/feedback

• Ad Creative Team: produces ad images and videos for your campaigns





Our Clients



Our clients are:

• Painting Contractors

• Based in USA and Canada

• Spending $1,000 - $3,000/month on ads

• Expecting consistent lead flow (typically 20–50 leads/month)



What Makes This Role Different

• This is not an eCommerce role — no ROAS obsession, complex funnels, or multi-step conversion paths

• Local lead gen is straightforward, but you’ll manage it at scale

• You’ll have full autonomy over campaign management (no micromanagement)

• You can earn up to $400/month in bonuses for crushing CPL targets



Compensation



Base Salary (Full-Time)

• $700–$900 USD/month (based on experience)

• 40 hours/week



Performance Bonuses (Monthly)



To qualify for bonuses, you must manage 40+ campaigns.



Example Monthly Earnings

• New hire (Month 1–2): $700 (ramp-up)

• Good performance: $900

• Great performance: $1,100

• Exceptional performance: $1,300

• Elite performance: $1,400



Payment Terms

• Paid monthly in arrears (within 7 business days of invoice)

• Paid via Wise (Wise Business account required)

• You’ll invoice monthly with a breakdown of base + bonuses



Required Skills & Experience

• 1–2+ years running
 Ads and/or Google Ads (local lead gen preferred)

• Proven ability to hit strong CPLs (ideally $30-40 CPL for service businesses)

• Strong understanding of core KPIs: CPL, CTR, CPC, frequency, conversion rate

• Experience in
 Ads Manager (setup, targeting, budgets, optimisation)

• Tech-savvy and fast learner (Slack, ---------- , GoHighLevel, Sheets)

• Detail-oriented and highly organised (40+ campaigns without errors)

• Coachable and able to implement feedback quickly



Preferred (Not Required)

• Experience running ads for trades/service businesses (painting. plumbing, electrical, HVAC, roofing)

• Experience with lead form ads 
 ads)

title: Customer Experience Agent — Multi-Brand Supplement Portfolio
description:
We run a portfolio of DTC supplement brands across Europe, the US, and Australia. We do $10M+/year and we're scaling fast. Customer experience is not a cost center for us — it's a brand-protection function. The person we hire owns it.

If you're looking for a quiet
-reply job where you copy-paste templates and clock out at 5pm, this isn't it. Keep scrolling.



What you'll actually own

 • Front-line customer communication across
 and chat for all our brands, in English (and additional languages welcome — DE, FR, IT, ES, NL, AU-EN all relevant). You're the voice of the brand.

 • Disputes and chargebacks in PayPal and Klarna. You hunt them down, document, win them. Current chargeback win rate target: 70%+.

 • Refunds, replacements, and Shopify workflows. You make judgment calls on edge cases — not every refund is automatic, not every complaint is valid. You d
 and report.

 • Working alongside our AI customer support agent in Commslayer. The AI drafts, you approve or improve. You're the quality bar, not the typing speed.

 • Pattern recognition. You see 50+ tickets a day. You'll spot product issues, fulfillment problems, or ad-customer mismatch before anyone else. You surface it weekly with proposed fixes — not as complaints.

 • CSAT, first-response time, and resolution rate are your KPIs. You hit them or we have a problem.



You're the right person if you can answer YES to all of these

 • You've handled customer support for an e-commerce brand before — minimum 2 years, ideally in supplements, beauty, or health/wellness

 • You write English so well a native speaker wouldn't notice you're not one

 • You've worked with PayPal disputes and Klarna chargebacks specifically (not just "I've used PayPal")

 • You're comfortable making decisions in grey areas without asking your manager every time

 • You see a customer complaint as data, not as drama

 • You can write a refund response that turns an angry customer into a repeat buyer (and you've actually done this)

 • You're proactive — when something's broken, you flag it AND propose the fix

You're the wrong person if any of these are true

 • You need step-by-step instructions for every situation

 • You think your job is to clear tickets, not solve customer problems

 • You're allergic to numbers (CSAT, response time, resolution rate — these will be measured)

 • You've never owned a chargeback dispute from start to finish

 • You want a job where nothing changes for the next 3 years



The screening step (do this before applying)

To filter out template-application candidates, we ask all serious applicants to complete one short task. Applications without this are auto-rejected.

Record a 3–5 minute Loom video (phone or laptop is fine) answering these:

 1 Introduce yourself. Name, country, current/last role, how many years in customer support for e-commerce.

 2 Show us your work. Walk us through one customer dispute or chargeback you handled — what happened, how you handled it, what the outcome was. Real example, real numbers if you have them.

 3 A real scenario. A customer
s saying: "I've been taking your product for 3 weeks. I haven't lost any weight. I want a full refund. Also I'm going to leave a 1-star review everywhere." Walk us through how you respond — what you write, what you check first, and what you would NOT do.

 4 Why this role specifically. Not why customer support in general — why this role, this company, this work.

Also send us:

 • Your CV

 • One example of an
 response you wrote to a difficult customer (anonymize names)

 • Your monthly comp expectation, in USD, full-time



Compensation & growth

 • Performance bonuses tied directly to CSAT, chargeback win rate, and first-response time (medal system — Bronze/Silver/Gold monthly)

 • Path to Senior CX role with team management responsibility within 12 months for top performers

 • Fully remote, work from anywhere your hours overlap with EU business hours



How to apply

Send your Loom video + CV

Subject line: "CX Agent — [Your Name]"

Deadline: 7 days from posting. Applications missing the Loom video will not be reviewed. We respond within 5 business days. If you don't hear back, it means we've moved forward with other candidates.

title: AI Cinematic Visual Creator / Realistic Image & Video Asset Producer
description:
We are looking for a person who can create a realistic, cinematic visual asset library for a confidential brand representative / persona operating in the space of spirituality, self-reflection, personal intention, nature, peace and symbolic journeys.

This project is confidential. The detailed character description, visual direction and full creative brief will only be shared with selected candidates after signing an NDA and intellectual property / confidentiality documents.



?



Goal of the First Project



We want to create a Phase 1 Visual Asset Pack — the first visual asset library for this project.



The materials should have the following atmosphere:



* cinematic,

* realistic,

* documentary-style,

* old travel archive,

* 35mm film,

* analog photography,

* spiritual,

* mysterious,

* premium,

* nature-based,

* symbolic,

* emotional,

* peaceful.



Acceptable filters and aesthetics include:



* 35mm film,

* analog grain,

* vintage documentary,

* old travel footage,

* handheld camera look,

* natural light,

* low-light ritual atmosphere,

* cinematic color grading,

* subtle blur,

* archival look.



The most important requirement: the materials must look natural and believable, without visible AI artifacts, artificial appearance, distorted hands, faces, clothes, symbols, text or background elements.



?



Visual Directions



We need materials inspired by different types of places, landscapes and spiritual environments, such as:



* jungle,

* rainforest,

* snowy north,

* mountains,

* desert,

* African landscapes,

* ocean,

* cliffs,

* caves,

* rivers,

* waterfalls,

* fire,

* fog,

* night sky,

* old stone places,

* temples / prayer spaces,

* symbolic places of power.



The materials should combine nature, silence, spiritual reflection, prayer, solitary journey, fire, water, earth, wind, night, snow and light.



Important: we do not want disrespectful, inauthentic or false representations of indigenous communities, religious leaders or recognizable real people. The materials should feel symbolic, cinematic and respectful.



?



Scope of Phase 1 Visual Asset Pack



Please provide your fixed project price and estimated delivery time for the following scope:



Images / Photos / Stills



* 100 photorealistic images / stills,

* mostly vertical 9:16 format,

* some horizontal frames for landing pages / backgrounds,

* different locations and atmospheres,

* consistent visual style.



Short Video Clips



* 30 short vertical video clips,

* 5–10 seconds each,

* 9:16 format,

* no text overlays,

* usable for Reels / TikTok / Shorts,

* realistic, cinematic style.



Ready-to-Use Reels



* 10 ready-to-use Reels / TikTok / Shorts,

* 10–20 seconds each,

* calm, cinematic editing style,

* no aggressive trend-style editing,

* with space for future voiceover or text overlay.



Documentation



Please also include:



* short visual style guide,

* prompt library / production notes,

* list of tools used,

* workflow information,

* recommendations for creating future materials in the same style.



?



Required Skills / Tools



We are looking for someone who can work with tools such as:



* Midjourney,

* Runway,

* Kling,

* Pika,

* Sora / Veo-style workflows,

* Leonardo AI,

* Photoshop,

* Lightroom,

* Premiere Pro,

* After Effects,

* DaVinci Resolve,

* CapCut,

* AI upscaling tools,

* cinematic editing tools.



You do not need to use all of these tools. What matters most is the final result: realistic, cinematic, consistent and premium-quality visuals.



?



Quality Requirements



The materials must:



* look realistic,

* be visually consistent,

* be suitable for premium social media,

* be prepared mainly in 9:16 format,

* have no visible AI artifacts,

* have no watermarks,

* contain no random text or distorted text,

* not violate copyright,

* not copy recognizable real people,

* not represent cultures or religions in a disrespectful or false way.



Please do not apply if you only create basic Canva posts. We are looking for someone with experience in realistic AI visuals, cinematic image/video generation and premium visual asset creation.



?



Confidentiality and Rights



This project is confidential.



Before starting the work, you will be required to sign:



* NDA,

* intellectual property transfer document,

* confidentiality rules,

* agreement not to publish or show the materials in your portfolio without our written approval.



After payment, all materials created for us must belong to our company, including:



* images,

* video clips,

* ready-to-use Reels,

* source files, if available,

* prompts,

* workflows,

* style guide,

* documentation,

* commercial usage rights.



You may not reuse, publish, sell or show our project materials without written approval.



?



Communication



We do not require live calls at this stage.



We prefer:



*
,

* text communication,

* Google Drive,

* shared documents,

* Loom / recorded video updates,

* short progress updates.



The work can be done asynchronously.



?



How to Apply



In the first line of your application, please write:



ARCHIVE



This helps us confirm that you have read the full job post.



Please include the following in your application:



1. Links to examples of realistic AI images you have created.

2. Links to examples of realistic AI videos or cinematic edits.

3. Information about the tools you use.

4. A short explanation of how you maintain visual consistency of a character / style across many assets.

5. A short explanation of how you avoid visible AI artifacts.

6. Your fixed price for the full Phase 1 Visual Asset Pack described above.

7. Your estimated delivery time for the full package.

8. Information on whether your price includes revisions, and how many revision rounds are included.

9. Your separate price for a small paid test.

10. Your estimated delivery time for the small paid test.

11. Confirmation whether all materials, prompts, workflows, files and commercial usage rights will be transferred after payment.

12. Confirmation whether you are comfortable signing NDA, IP transfer and confidentiality documents.

13. Information on whether you can start immediately.



?



Small Paid Test



Before assigning the full package, we may ask selected candidates to complete a small paid test.



The mini-test may include:



* 5 photorealistic stills,

* 2 short video clips, 5–8 seconds each,

* 1 short Reel, 10–15 seconds,

* a short explanation of your process and tools used.



Please include a separate price and delivery time for this mini-test in your application.

title: Experienced US Bookkeeper for real estate investment company
description:
Key Responsibilities and Success Metrics 



We are a growing real estate investment company focused on multifamily acquisitions and operations, with a specialty in manufactured housing communities. As we continue to expand our portfolio, we are looking to hire a detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our team and support day-to-day accounting operations across our entities and properties.



Bookkeeper



Complete initial data entries and ongoing coding of bank/credit card activity for each entity/property into AppFolio and QuickBooks, which may include but isn’t limited to, tenant rent, owner contributions/distributions, mortgage/loan payments, insurance, taxes, expenses, and reimbursements. 



Categorize transactions to the correct entity/property, class, and account (including proper treatment of capital improvements vs. operating expenses) and reconcile source data to statements. 



The expectation is to research transaction types (historical books, vendor websites/invoices, lease terms, and prior-period coding) before escalating questions to a senior tea
mber, and to document any new coding rules for consistency.



• Measure of Success: 95%+ transaction coding accuracy (entity/property/class/account) and monthly bank/credit card reconciliations completed within 15 days of statement availability

• Measure of Success: All recurring vendors, rent deposits, loan payments, and reserve transfers are set up with consistent coding rules and documented so that month-over-month reporting is stable and easy to review.

• Measure of Success: Open reconciliation items (unmatched transactions, bank-to-book differences, uncleared deposits/charges) are tracked and resolved within the next close cycle, with clear notes for any timing differences.

 

Assist in the preparation of monthly statements including:  

• Profit/Loss Statement

• Balance Sheet

• Cash Flow Statement

• Expense reports

• Unidentified credit card expense reports

  

• Measure of Success: Less than 15% of prepared financial statements require rework due to bookkeeper-controlled items (coding, reconciliations, missing schedules).

• Reports are delivered by the agreed monthly deadline and include clear property/entity-level support (e.g., key schedules for loans, reserves, capex, and owner activity) when applicable.

• Measure of Success: Month-end close checklist items owned by the bookkeeper (reconciliations, schedules, accrual/deferral support when used) are completed on time and signed off with minimal follow-up questions from leadership or the CPA.



Qualifications 

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

• 2 years+ of US bookkeeping experience with a U.S. accounting, finance, or real estate firm

• Required proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) or similar software

o AppFolio experience is preferred but not required. 

• Strong communication skills, both written and verbal

• Strong analytical skills and worth ethic

• Interest in real estate

• Tech-savvy, with proficiency in tools such as Microsoft Excel

title: Account Support Specialist - (US Freight Brokerage) (Remote in PH)
description:
ACCOUNT SUPPORT SPECIALIST

Remote, Philippines (US Freight Brokerage)

 

 

ABOUT PINNACLE LOGISTICS GROUP

 

Pinnacle Logistics Group is a Phoenix, Arizona based tech-enabled freight brokerage and 3PL. We move LTL, truckload, drayage, ocean, and Mexico cross-border freight for shippers across the US. Our tagline is "Complex Transportation Made Simple," and our customers stay with us because we deliver on it. We are profitable, ~$35M in annual revenue, and growing. We already work with a great team of ~35 people in the Philippines.

 

This role specifically supports our US LTL and Truckload divisions. You will not be working with our Drayage, Ocean, or Mexico cross-border divisions.  Those divisions have their own account managers you'd coordinate with if the need comes up.

 

 

THE ROLE

 

We have 150 active customers and a Senior Account Manager who needs a partner. You will work directly with her to make sure every customer is getting the most out of their relationship with Pinnacle. This is a strategic, relationship-driven role, not a transactional one.

 

 

WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO

- Lead and prep quarterly business reviews with customers, covering volume trends, service performance, and where we can do more for them

- Proactively check in with customers to catch issues before they escalate and surface ideas to improve their experience

- Help customers expand their use of our LTL and truckload services and uncover more freight we should be moving for them

- Own customer escalations and account-level issues that fall outside day-to-day shipment ops

- Keep customer accounts, contacts, and notes organized in Airtable and Close CRM

- Be the right hand to our Senior Account Manager on every meaningful customer touchpoint

 

 

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

- Not load-by-load operations. You will not build loads in our TMS, track shipments, or dispatch carriers. We have separate teams for that

- Not cold sales. You are not chasing brand new customers

- Not a junior CSR role. You are a strategic partner to a senior account manager

 

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Minimum 2 years in a customer-facing role at a US freight brokerage or US freight forwarder. Titles like Account Manager, Account Executive, Customer Success Manager, Account Coordinator, or Account Specialist all fit

- Excellent written and spoken English. You will be on calls,
s, and chats with US customers daily

- Comfortable with US business culture and the direct, professional, friendly communication US shippers expect

- Self-managing and proactive. You should be able to own a customer relationship without being told what to do next

- Organized with software. We use Airtable, Close CRM, Front, Google Workspace, and a custom TMS we are building (flowTMS)

- Strong instincts for finding the next opportunity inside an existing customer relationship

 

 

BONUS POINTS

- LTL-specific experience

 

 

COMPENSATION AND LOGISTICS

- Full-time, long-term, remote

- US business hours, Mountain Standard Time. Arizona does not observe daylight saving

- Competitive base in USD plus performance bonus tied to customer retention and account growth

- 13th month bonus

- Paid time off

 

 

HOW TO APPLY

 

Send a short message that includes all four of the following. Applications missing any one of these will not be considered.

 

- Where you worked as a customer-facing person at a US freight brokerage or forwarder, and for how long

- One example of a customer relationship you owned or contributed to, and what made it successful

- Your monthly salary expectation in USD

- A short video, one to two minutes, introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a good fit for this role specifically

 

Put "Account Support Specialist Application" as the subject line so we know you read this posting all the way through.

Think of B&Q as a simpler version of Amazon. The logic is the same — listings, account health, order management, and paid advertising — but the platform is leaner and less complex. If you have owned an Amazon account and run PPC campaigns there, you will pick up B&Q quickly. That is exactly the profile we are hiring for.



B&Q runs on the Mirakl platform. You will be trained on its specifics, but your Amazon instincts are what will make you effective from day one.



Listings and account health



-Taking full ownership of our B&Q marketplace account

-Applying Amazon-grade listing standards to B&Q — titles, attributes, categorisation, images, content quality, and keyword logic translated into Mirakl’s framework

-Catching and resolving platform issues fast — listing rejections, content errors, order anomalies, platform notifications — the same discipline you would bring to a suppressed ASIN or account health warning on Amazon

-Building and maintaining clean, complete, high-performing listings across our full product catalogue



PPC — paid advertising on B&Q



-Managing paid advertising campaigns on the B&Q platform — the mechanics are simpler than Amazon PPC, but the same strategic thinking applies

-Keyword targeting, bid management, and performance monitoring to drive visibility and sales

-Tracking advertising spend against revenue and optimising toward a clear TACoS or cost-of-sale target

-This is a core part of the role, not an optional extra



What we expect from you



-You treat the B&Q account like it is your own business — you do not wait to be told what to check

-You bring Amazon discipline to a new platform: structured, data-driven, proactive

-You understand PPC at a strategic level — you know why a campaign is or is not working, not just how to change a bid

-If you are serious about this role, start your cover letter with the words — diversification is a way to go.

-You communicate clearly in writing and flag problems early, not after they cost money

-You work full-time, 40 hours per week, and you log your time in Clockify



Requirements



-Solid hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience — real account ownership, not agency dashboard watching

-Proven PPC experience on Amazon — Sponsored Products at minimum, Sponsored Brands a plus — with real TACoS or ACoS results you can speak to

-Comfort with learning new marketplace back-ends — Mirakl experience is a plus but not required if your Amazon foundations are strong

-Tools you must know: Amazon Seller Central, Asana, Google Sheets — state clearly in your application which of these you have used and at what level

-Familiarity with Helium 10 or a comparable keyword and analytics tool



What success looks like in this role



-B&Q account health is green and stays green

-Listings are complete, accurate, and optimised — no content errors, no rejected listings sitting unresolved

-SLAs are met consistently — zero avoidable late or cancelled orders

-Advertising spend is tracked, optimised, and moving toward TACoS targets month over month

-Weekly B&Q performance report lands every Monday without being chased

-Problems reach the Catalog Manager before they become expensive

title: Professional Phone Caller / Appointment Setter
description:
We run a recruiting and AI integration company. We place AI-trained Filipino VAs into home services, insurance, and recruiting businesses in the U.S.



I'm hiring 1-2 phone callers / appointment setters to work my own incoming leads and burn through call lists.



What you'll do:



- Call business owners who replied to my cold
 (warm leads — they already said "tell me more")

- Run through cold call lists in home services, insurance, and recruiting niches

- Use a tight script (provided) to qualify the lead and book a 15-min call

- Take notes, update the CRM, follow up on no-answers

- Daily 15-min check-in



What I need:



- Native-level or near-native English (clear accent, natural pace)

- Some phone sales / appointment setting / closer experience, ideally with U.S. clients

- Reliable internet and a quiet workspace

- Available 4+ hours/day during U.S. business hours (we can flex on timezone)

- Willing to learn AI tools — we'll train you, but you have to want to use them



What you'll get:



- $5-7/hour to start, paid weekly (Wise / Payoneer / PayPal — your call)

- Raise to $8-10/hr after 30 days if you're hitting numbers

- Bonuses on calls booked (small but real)

- Real AI training — you walk away with a skill set that's worth a lot

- Long-term role if it's a fit — we're growing



How to apply:

1.
 us at 
 with the subject line "AI Guy Setter Application." (we only process applications of those who sends us an
)

2. Attach an Audio recording of yourself reading a sample script out loud, just like you'd be on a real call. Use your phone or laptop mic — quality doesn't have to be studio, but the room should be quiet enough to hear you clearly.



Upload the recording to Google Drive (or any file share) and paste the link in your
. Or attach an MP3 directly.



What we're looking for: clarity, pace, and natural energy. You don't have to be perfect. You have to sound like someone I'd want to pick up the phone on the other end.



Sample Script — read this out loud, naturally:



> Hi, [Name]? Hey — this is [Your Name], calling on behalf of Justin over at AI Integraterz. You replied to his
 earlier this week about the AI-trained setters for home services.

>

> [pause]

>

> Awesome. Justin asked me to give you a quick call to see if it makes sense to set up a 15-minute chat with him directly. Before I do that, can I ask you a couple quick questions about your business?

>

> [pause]

>

> Great. First — when you replied, what specifically caught your attention? The setter idea, or something else we mentioned like marketing or recruiting help?

>

> [pause for answer]

>

> Got it. And right now, who's working your list of past customers and old estimates — is that you, your office staff, or basically nobody?

>

> [pause for answer]

>

> Makes sense. Last one — if Justin could help you get that running smoothly in the next 30 days, would that be worth a 15-minute call to see if it's a fit? No pitch, no commitment.

>

> [pause for answer]

>

> Perfect. I've got Justin's calendar open right now. What works better for you — mornings or afternoons? Tuesday and Thursday are mostly open this week.

>

> [pause]

>

>

> [pause]

>

> Awesome. Thanks for your time, [Name] — talk to you soon.

title: Full Time Dispatcher
description:
About the Role



We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Dispatcher with a positive attitude and excellent communication skills. The ideal candidate will have expertise in load negotiation, scheduling, and route planning, while adhering to DOT and ELD regulations.



Vehicles Being Dispatched



26-Foot Box Trucks (10,000 lb weight capacity) – Dock-high with lift gate

Sprinter Vans / Cargo Vans / Ram ProMaster (High Roof)



About Us



Eveready Express is a well-established leader in the trucking, courier, logistics, and distribution industries, founded in 1984. We pride ourselves on honesty, integrity, and mutual respect.



Key Responsibilities

Dispatching Vehicles



Negotiate rates with drivers while aiming for a minimum 40% margin, and assign vehicles to specific routes and deliveries based on customer orders, schedules, and driver availability.



Communication with Drivers



Maintain constant communication with drivers by providing instructions, updates, and support throughout their routes.



Routing and Scheduling



Plan efficient routes to minimize travel time, fuel costs, and vehicle wear. Adjust schedules as needed to accommodate changes or unexpected events.



Tracking Shipments



Monitor shipments in real time using tracking systems and GPS technology. Address delays or issues as they arise.



Customer Interaction



Serve as the primary point of contact for customers after dispatch, providing delivery updates, addressing inquiries, and resolving concerns or complaints promptly.



Documentation



Maintain accurate records of trucking activities, including driver logs, delivery schedules, and customer communications. Ensure compliance with company policies and regulations (e.g., BOL, POD).



Problem-Solving



Resolve logistical problems or emergencies such as vehicle breakdowns, traffic delays, or adverse weather conditions.



Safety Compliance



Ensure trucks and drivers comply with safety regulations and company policies. Regularly verify driver credentials, vehicle maintenance, and adherence to transportation laws in collaboration with HR.



Team Collaboration



Work closely with Customer Service, Fleet Drivers, Billing, Sales, HR, and Warehouse staff to coordinate operations and improve efficiency.



Continuous Improvement



Identify and suggest improvements to dispatching processes, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency. Offer feedback and innovative solutions to the management team.



Working on Load Boards



Bid on Sylectus, DAT, Amazon Relay, and other broker platforms during the off-peak season.



Qualifications



• At least 2 years of experience in the U.S. logistics industry, with proven experience in dispatching, logistics coordination, or transportation management.



• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively interact with drivers, customers, and tea
mbers.



• Excellent organizational and multitasking skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.



• Proficiency in dispatching software, GPS systems, and other relevant technology tools.



• Knowledge of transportation regulations, safety procedures, and industry best practices.



• Ability to remain calm under pressure, with a problem-solving mindset and flexibility to adapt to changing circumstances.



• Availability to work irregular hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, to ensure 24/7 coverage.



Hardware & Technical Requirements



• Processor: 2.0 GHz or higher (Intel Core i5/i7 preferred)

• RAM: Minimum 8 GB

• Disk Space: 100 GB of free space

• A second monitor for multitasking

• Backup computer

• Noise-canceling headset

• Internet: Minimum 20  Mbps wired connection for both primary and backup ISPs

• USB sticks are not allowed for backup ISP connections



Perks of the Job



• Competitive weekly salary

• Opportunity to receive HMO benefits

• Opportunities for advancement within the company



To Apply



Please send an
 with the subject line:



“I want to dispatch for Eveready”



to 



Your
 must include:



• A voice recording (via Speakpipe or Vocaroo) explaining why you are a good fit for the role

• A PDF copy of your resume

• A photo of your workstation

• A screenshot of your internet speed test from speedtest.net



Please follow all instructions above. Only applicants who demonstrate genuine interest in the role will be considered.



If selected, you will be invited to a brief
 or Google Meet interview, which will require a video call.



Equal Opportunity Employer



Eveready Express is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on race, religion, color, disability, medical condition, genetic information, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, gender identity or expression, sex (including pregnancy), age, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.



We are committed to fostering a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion.



Note



Eveready Express reserves the right to modify job duties and assignments at any time. The job description provided is not all-encompassing and may change depending on business needs.

Alert Monitoring - Review Datto RMM and EDR alerts every morning. Investigate, resolve, escalate to Datto when needed, and proactively notify affected clients.

Backup Monitoring - Watch Datto backup status daily, troubleshoot failures, escalate as needed.

Strong Windows troubleshooting and domain networking fundamentals

Datto RMM/EDR console experience and Datto backup deployment/troubleshooting

English at C2 level (spoken and written)

Available during US Eastern business hours

A reliable primary workstation plus a backup machine (you cannot be offline when a client needs you)

Quiet, professional work environment



SOFT SKILLS

Self-starter who reaches out for help instead of staying stuck

Empathetic, kind communication style with clients

TO APPLY
